name: Marrying A Divorced Person
overview: Scripture clearly emphasizes the sanctity and permanence of marriage, warning against divorcing a spouse except in the case of fornication. Jesus teaches that divorcing a wife without this cause and marrying another constitutes adultery, and similarly, marrying a divorced person who was put away unlawfully also results in committing adultery. The Lord expresses His hatred for divorce, highlighting the seriousness of treacherous dealings in marriage and calling believers to uphold faithfulness and integrity in their marital relationships.
